# Fixture Catalog

Every fixture in this directory has a deterministic expected outcome so CI can
run at least one happy path and one failure path (Recommendation 1 US-02).
GeoJSON fixtures are checked in; the zipped Shapefile bundles are generated by
`make fixtures` (see below) to keep binaries out of Git.

## GeoJSON fixtures (checked in)

| Fixture | Expected outcome | Error code |
|---|---|---|
| `simple-parcels.geojson` | Happy path. 3 parcels → MVT polygon tiles, `parcelId`/`assetId` preserved, `ownerName` stripped | — |
| `assets-points.geojson` | Happy path. 4 asset points → MVT point tiles | — |
| `invalid-polygon.geojson` | Rejected. Ring collapses to < 3 distinct points, all features unrecoverable → `GEOMETRY_ERRORS` at the `NORMALIZING` stage; source quarantined | `GEOMETRY_ERRORS` |
| `null-island.geojson` | Happy path with warning. The `(0,0)` feature is counted and warned (classic geocoding failure), the valid parcel still tiles | — |
| `oversized-properties.geojson` | Happy path. `ownerName`/`mailing_address` removed by the PII denylist; the remaining attributes are truncated to the 512-byte per-feature payload cap | — |

## Shapefile fixtures (generated by `make fixtures`)

`make fixtures` runs `crates/vtile-ingest/examples/gen_fixtures.rs`, which uses
the `vtile_ingest::shapefile::write` module to emit byte-exact bundles here:

| Fixture | Expected outcome | Error code |
|---|---|---|
| `small-parcels.zip` | Happy path. `.shp` + `.shx` + `.dbf` + `.prj` (WGS84) → 3 parcel polygons tiled | — |
| `missing-dbf.zip` | Rejected at bundle validation: "Missing required .dbf file." | `MISSING_SHAPEFILE_COMPONENTS` |
| `missing-prj.zip` | Rejected with `UNKNOWN_CRS` under the default `RequireKnown` policy; succeeds on replay with `--assume-wgs84` (TRD §10 user confirmation) | `UNKNOWN_CRS` |

## Running them locally

```bash
make fixtures          # generate the .zip bundles (requires cargo)
make run-local         # start vtile-api on :8080
make seed              # push every fixture through the upload API
make job-status JOB_ID=<id>
```

The end-to-end tests in `crates/vtile-pipeline/tests/end_to_end.rs` exercise
the same fixtures in-process, including the failure paths and the
quarantine → replay round-trip.
